# I build to learn

I'm Satvik Raman, a Grade 12 student in Bengaluru. I start with a question, build something to answer it, and learn from what it shows me. So far that has meant surveying 40 security guards at IISc, building a voicebot that answers money questions in Indian languages, writing 125+ posts explaining economics in English, translated into five more languages, and building Systematick, a tool for testing trading ideas on honest market history. I also play central midfield for Bengaluru FC's Young Blues Elite.
